title: InstitutionPolicyVersion
description: Immutable reviewed safety defaults used by new policy decisions.

created_at.description: UTC instant of initial durable creation. Server assigned.

effective_at.description: Inclusive activation time. New decisions select the latest approved effective revision.

idle_session_minutes.description: Idle timeout for an ordinary interactive session.

absolute_session_minutes.description: Absolute timeout. Cannot be less than idle timeout.

recent_auth_minutes.description: Age limit for sensitive self-service and elevated approvals.

standing_role_review_days.description: Periodic review deadline for indefinite grants.

guardian_review_days.description: Maximum approved guardian term before review.

privacy_due_days.description: Operational case target subject to approved institutional law and records policy.

examination_zero_acknowledged_loss.description: Whether high-stakes exam release requires tested zero loss of acknowledged submissions in the declared failure domain.

approval_ref.description: Protected evidence of applicable law, scope and review.

x-invariants: Publication does not reinterpret deadlines or rewrite approved custody evidence. Revocation or tighter authentication policy can invalidate access immediately.
A deployment cannot claim high-assurance exam readiness without passing the corresponding recovery profile.
